panel.evidence: packages/sheets/test/sheet/data-validation.test.ts:66-69 comments "Toggle is a no-op: reports false, keeps the formula, writes no literal" but the only post-toggle assertions are `toggleCheckboxAt(...) === false` and `cell?.f === '=1=1'`. `cell?.v` (the formula-computed value the checkbox actually renders from — gridcanvas.ts:1042 uses `cell?.v`) is never asserted before or after, so a regression that preserved `f` while clobbering `v` (or one where the formula never evaluated at all) passes.
